scope: Local Convex-test, SQLite FakeBank, simulated human identities, synthetic text originals. No external provider or model execution.
recordTransform: case-transitions.json retains the actual events, versions, commands, journals and checks from agent-case-flow.json; counts are measured from the saved arrays. Original bodies and duplicate copies in case.timeline are omitted. process-recovery.json is copied unchanged. bankRecords retains safe identity, amount and status fields from the actual FakeBank records; the pending record and posted debit are counted separately.
reproduce: mkdir -p var/agent-transition-evidence && AP_AGENT_EVIDENCE_DIR=$PWD/var/agent-transition-evidence npm exec vitest run tests/ap-system/agent-workflow.test.ts tests/ap-system/agent-process.test.ts
limitations: No new external sandbox or actual model-selected tool verification.
Process restart keeps the parent Convex-test state and advances lease expiry; not a database restart.
Existing source-only events are not backfilled.
Every denied API attempt is not audited.
